title: 第5章 珍宝楼第6章 明月楼第7章 回归
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
青石镇的热闹，不仅仅在那喧闹无比、人声鼎沸的繁华市场里鲜明地呈现，更是在人们幸福和乐、其乐融融的生活氛围中生动地展露无遗。
这里的人们热情好客，对外来的客人也十分友好，让人倍感亲切。
在凌宇看来，太虚宗的管理模式还是挺成功的，如果换成是魔宗统治之下的话，也许就会是另外一种场景了。
在青石镇的热闹中，凌宇和张浩也穿梭在人群之中。
他们被这热闹的氛围所感染，心情格外愉悦。
张浩四处张望，对一切都充满了好奇。他看到了一个灵果的小摊，五颜六色的灵果散发着诱人的香味，让他挪不开脚步。
“哇，这些灵果看起来好好吃啊！”张浩忍不住说道。
“别馋了，我们还有正事要办呢。”凌宇笑着拉了拉他。
一会又被一个制作灵食的摊位吸引住了，看着师傅灵巧的双手将面团变成各种栩栩如生的形象，让他不禁赞叹不已。
“这手艺也太厉害了吧！”张浩惊叹。
“要不是我们还有别的事，我都想让你在这儿看一天了。”凌宇无奈地说，心中不禁感叹:“果然还是一个小孩子！好奇心就是重。”
要不是凌宇拉着，他那点灵石早就给花完了。
更别说是买丹药了，恐怕这会儿早就被他抛到脑后了。
青石镇的热闹仿佛是一幅生动的画卷，凌宇和张浩陶醉其中，尽情享受着这个充满生机和活力的地方带给他们的快乐。
他们融入了这热闹的氛围，感受着小镇的独特魅力。
一时这段时间修炼带来的心理疲惫也得到了释放，一张一弛果然有助于修行，有时候享受享受还是有必要的。
很快，凌宇和张浩来到了他们的主要目的地——珍宝楼。
这座楼阁气势恢宏，门口人流如织，是青石镇最大的丹药和法器商店。
凌宇踏入店内，目光立刻被琳琅满目的丹药和法器所吸引。
他一边仔细挑选，一边心中思考着自己的需求。

店员热情地迎了上来，微笑着询问：“两位客人，需要些什么？我可以为你们介绍一下。”
凌宇礼貌地回应：“我想挑选一些适合秘境使用的丹药和法器。”
店员点了点头，开始详细介绍各种丹药的功效和价格。
“我们这里有恢复真元的补气丹，一粒只需100下品灵石；回元丹效果更好，200下品灵石一粒；而真元丹则是恢复效果最好丹药，300下品灵石一粒。”店员指着货架上的丹药介绍。
凌宇思考片刻，决定每种丹药都购买三粒。
他深知在秘境中，灵力的快速恢复至关重要，看了一眼张浩，活生生的例子就在眼前，容不得一丝马虎。
接着，凌宇又问:“有没有恢复精神力的丹药”。
店员连忙介绍：“养神丹有助于恢复精神力，400下品灵石一粒。安神丹则能让你的精神更加稳定，300下品灵石一粒。”凌宇考虑之后，各买了三粒。
然后，店员向凌宇推荐了恢复体力的回力丹和回春丹，“回力丹能迅速恢复体力，一粒100下品灵石，回春丹的效果更显着，200下品灵石一粒。”
凌宇觉得体力的恢复也不能忽视，便各买了三粒。
content_en:
The liveliness of Qingshi Town is not only vividly displayed in the noisy and bustling market, but also vividly displayed in the happy and harmonious living atmosphere of people.
The people here are warm and hospitable, and are also very friendly to outside guests, which makes people feel cordial.
In Ling Yu's view, the Taixu Sect's management model was quite successful. If it were under the rule of the Demon Sect, it might be a different situation.
In the bustle of Qingshi Town, Ling Yu and Zhang Hao also shuttled among the crowd.
They were infected by the lively atmosphere and felt particularly happy.
Zhang Hao looked around, full of curiosity about everything. He saw a stall selling spiritual fruits. The colorful spiritual fruits exuded an alluring fragrance that made him unable to move away.
"Wow, these spiritual fruits look delicious!" Zhang Hao couldn't help but say.
"Don't be greedy, we still have business to do." Ling Yu smiled and pulled him.
After a while, he was attracted by a stall making spiritual food. Watching the master's dexterous hands turn the dough into various lifelike images, he couldn't help but marvel.
"This craftsmanship is so amazing!" Zhang Hao exclaimed.
"If we had nothing else to do, I would have wanted you to watch here all day." Ling Yu said helplessly, and couldn't help but sigh in his heart: "Sure enough, he is still a child! He is very curious."
If Ling Yu hadn't held him back, all his spiritual stones would have been spent long ago.
Let alone buying elixirs, I'm afraid he has already forgotten about it.
The bustle of Qingshi Town seemed like a vivid picture. Ling Yu and Zhang Hao were intoxicated, enjoying the happiness brought to them by this vibrant and vibrant place.
They blended into the lively atmosphere and felt the unique charm of the town.
The mental exhaustion caused by cultivation during this period was also relieved. Relaxation really helps cultivation. Sometimes it is necessary to enjoy it.
Soon, Ling Yu and Zhang Hao arrived at their main destination - Zhenbao Tower.
This pavilion is majestic and crowded with people at the entrance. It is the largest elixir and magic weapon store in Qingshi Town.
Ling Yu stepped into the store and his eyes were immediately attracted by the dazzling array of elixirs and magical artifacts.
While he was choosing carefully, he was thinking about his needs.
The clerk greeted him warmly and asked with a smile: "Two guests, what do you need? I can introduce it to you."
Ling Yu responded politely: "I want to select some elixirs and magic weapons suitable for use in the secret realm."
The clerk nodded and began to introduce the effects and prices of various elixirs in detail.
"We have a Qi-Building Pill here to restore true energy, one pill only costs 100 lower-grade spiritual stones; the Recovery Pill is more effective and costs 200 lower-grade spiritual stones; and the True Yuan Pill is the pill with the best recovery effect and only costs 300 lower-grade spiritual stones." The clerk introduced, pointing to the pills on the shelf.
Ling Yu thought for a moment and decided to buy three pills of each pill.
He knew that in the secret realm, the rapid recovery of spiritual power was crucial. He glanced at Zhang Hao and saw that the living example was right in front of him, and there was no room for sloppiness.
Then, Ling Yu asked: "Is there any pill to restore mental strength?"
The clerk quickly introduced: "The Nourishing Pill can help restore your mental power, costing 400 low-grade spiritual stones per pill. The Soothing Pill can make your spirit more stable, costing 300 low-grade spiritual stones per pill." After Ling Yu considered it, he bought three pills of each.
Then, the clerk recommended to Ling Yu the Rejuvenation Pill and Rejuvenation Pill, which can restore physical strength. "The Rejuvenation Pill can quickly restore physical strength. One 100-low-grade spiritual stone. The effect of the Rejuvenation Pill is even more significant. One 200-low-grade spiritual stone."
Ling Yu felt that the recovery of physical strength could not be ignored, so he bought three pills each.
